perceived enjoyment has a positive effect on continuance usage intention, perceived usefulness has a negative effect on continuance intention, and structural embeddedness has a positive effect.

the understanding of the determinants of continuance usage of SNS.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the research has successfully extended the ECM to SNS usage continuance and provided a theoretical foundation for the study of SNS continuance intention.

our study provides a better understanding of continuance usage of social networking services (S NS) by proposing and empirically examining a theoretical model based on expectation-confirmation model of information system (IS) continuance.
the study has contributed to the literature by providing an empirical examination of continuance usage of SNS in China.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the continuance intention of social networking services is influenced by both individual motivations such as usefulness and perceived enjoyment, as well as non-individual motivation like structural embeddedness.
the ECM of IS usage continuance is applicable to SNS, but with the inclusion of structural embeddedness as a new factor.
we provide a theoretical model to understand the continuance usage intention of SNS users.
The main takeaway from our work is that

SNS users are motivated to continue their usage not only by their own individual motivations (i.e., perceived usefulness and perceived enjoyability), but also by their social embeddedness in SNS networks.
SNS providers need to consider not only users’ individual motivations but also the structural embeddedness when developing their SNS services.
